permissions.purpose: Read captured card payments and refunded amounts to determine whether a refund request is eligible.
Create an approved card Refund on the installed account after a separate user approves the request.
Read the PaymentIntent linked to a Dashboard payment and reject unsupported or uncaptured payments.
Reconcile Refund events and identify refunds created outside RefundDesk.

content_security_policy.purpose: Send authenticated refund workflow, settings, alert, and audit requests to the RefundDesk API.
